extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: covered wagon without draft animals, 5.6 m long incl. tongue, 2.1 m wide, 3.1 m tall, rear wheels 1.36 m, front wheels 1 m
extras.notes: Conestoga style wagon: sky blue boat shaped bed with iron straps, cream canvas cover over seven wooden bows, puckered ends with drawstring, red brown running gear, tongue with doubletree, water barrel on a side shelf, leather water bag, lazy board, cargo of barrels, sacks and a crate, glowing lantern at the front (separate object, not baked). Wheels 'covered-wagon_wheel_fl/fr/rl/rr' are separate objects with the origin in the hub (rotate around local X). Tongue points to -Y

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
